title: AWS SRE Lead
description:
**Position:**  
AWS SRE Lead
  
  
**Job Description:**  
Key Responsibilities Requirements
  
  

* Lead SRE practices and initiatives to improve availability, reliability, scalability, performance, and operational efficiency of AWS-based applications and infrastructure.
* Design and implement highly available and resilient AWS architectures, with strong understanding of services such as EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS/Aurora, CloudFront, Route 53, CloudWatch, and other core AWS services.
* DriveDevOps automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation/CDK, Ansible, and scripting languages such as Python or Shell.
* Design and manageCI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, or similar DevOps platforms, with focus on deployment automation and release reliability.
* Establish and improveobservability and monitoring practices, including metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, and proactive detection using tools such as CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, or equivalent technologies.
* Own and driveincident, problem, and change management processes, including production troubleshooting, root-cause analysis (RCA), corrective actions, and prevention of recurring incidents.
* Define and trackSRE metrics and practices, including SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, availability, latency, MTTR, MTBF, and capacity/utilization metrics.
* Implementautomation and self-healing mechanisms to eliminate repetitive operational activities, reduce manual intervention, and improve MTTR and overall system reliability.
* Develop and maintainbackup, disaster recovery, business continuity, scalability, and capacity-management strategies for critical AWS workloads and applications.
* Lead and mentor SRE/DevOps engineers, conduct technical reviews, establish engineering standards, collaborate with development/security/architecture teams, and continuously improve the organizations DevOps and SRE maturity.

Technology Stack / Expected Exposure
  
  

* Cloud: AWS
* IaC: Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK
* CI/CD: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps
* Containers: Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, ECS
* Monitoring Observability: CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch
* Configuration/Automation: Ansible
* Scripting: Python, Shell/Bash
* Version Control: Git, GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket
* Networking: VPC, Load Balancers, Route 53, CloudFront, DNS, TCP/IP
* SRE: SLI/SLO/SLA, Error Budgets, Incident Management, RCA, Capacity Planning, DR

**Preferred:** AWS certification such asAWS Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or SysOps Administrator, along with hands-on experience managing large-scale production AWS environments.
  
  
**Location:**  
IN-GJ-Ahmedabad, India-Ognaj (eInfochips)
  
  
**Time Type:**  
Full time
  
  
**Job Category:**  
Engineering Services

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**Job Description: Senior DevOps Engineer (Cloud Architecture & Security)**  
**Experience Required:** 8 to 10 years  
**Location:** Ahmedabad Only  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Shift Timings:** Monday to Friday, with alternate Saturdays as working days. Rotational shifts are scheduled between 8:00 AM and 11:00 PM IST.

**About the Role**  
We are looking for a hands-on Senior DevOps Engineer with 8 to 10 years of experience to design, secure, and manage our infrastructure and deployment ecosystem. The ideal candidate can work across the full stack, from OS-level administration to cloud architecture, security, and CI/CD automation, and can guide and mentor junior team members.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement scalable, highly available, and secure cloud architectures on AWS.
* Define and enforce infrastructure security standards, including system hardening, IAM policies, network segmentation, and secrets management.
* Conduct security audits, vulnerability assessments, and remediation, and support compliance requirements.
* Install, configure, and maintain Linux servers (Ubuntu/CentOS/RHEL), including user management, permissions, cron jobs, and log management.
* Configure, manage, and troubleshoot Apache and Nginx (virtual hosts, reverse proxy, load balancing, SSL/TLS).
* Install, configure, and maintain MySQL/SQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB (backups, restores, replication, performance tuning).
* Set up and deploy applications built on PHP (LAMP/LEMP), Python (Django/Flask, Gunicorn/uWSGI), and the MEAN and MERN stacks.
* Manage and deploy applications using AWS services: EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, Route 53, ELB/ALB, CloudWatch, and Auto Scaling.
* Design, build, and manage CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) with security checks integrated into the pipeline.
* Containerize and orchestrate applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
* Set up monitoring, logging, and alerting using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch, Nagios, or Zabbix.
* Plan and implement backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity strategies.
* Manage DNS, SSL certificates, and domain configurations.
* Write and maintain shell/bash scripts for automation.
* Collaborate with development teams to streamline deployments and reduce downtime.
* Lead troubleshooting of production issues and root-cause analysis.
* Mentor junior engineers and review their infrastructure and deployment work.

**Required Skills**

* 8 to 10 years of hands-on experience in Linux administration and DevOps.
* Proven experience in designing cloud and infrastructure architecture for production environments.
* Strong experience in infrastructure and cloud security, including hardening, IAM, firewalls, WAF, and vulnerability management.
* Strong working knowledge of Apache and Nginx.
* Experience administering SQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
* Practical experience deploying PHP, Python, MEAN, and/or MERN applications.
* Solid understanding of AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, Load Balancers, Route 53).
* Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar).
* Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Proficiency in Shell/Bash scripting; Python scripting is a plus.
* Experience with IaC and configuration management tools (Terraform, Ansible).
* Working knowledge of Git and version control workflows.
* Strong understanding of networking (DNS, TCP/IP, firewalls, load balancing, SSL/TLS).
* Experience with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch).
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication skills and the ability to lead and work in a collaborative team.

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

description:
***About Media NV***

Established in 2014, Media NV is a multinational company headquartered in North America, with offices in Ahmedabad and Chandigarh. We provide digital marketing and IT services, helping businesses strengthen their online presence through creativity, technology, and innovation.

At Media NV, we believe in working as a family and creating an environment where employees can learn, grow, and contribute to meaningful projects.

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
company: Jay Maharaj Software Consulting Pvt Ltd
description:
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 3–5 years  
**Shift:** **3:00 PM to 12:00 AM**  
**Work Mode:** On\-site

**About Us**

JMSC POS is a point\-of\-sale and inventory management platform serving **800–1,000 convenience stores, liquor stores, grocery stores, tobacco shops, and gas stations across the United States**.

Our infrastructure runs entirely on **AWS** and is managed as code using **Terraform**. We are looking for a **Senior DevOps Engineer** to take a key role in maintaining, improving, and scaling our production infrastructure while working closely with our CTO.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Design, manage, and maintain infrastructure as code using **Terraform** across a multi\-account AWS Organization, including Dev, QA, UAT, Production, Sandbox, and DevOps environments.
* Manage and optimize containerized services running on **Amazon ECS Fargate**, including deployments, scaling, performance, and troubleshooting.
* Manage and support **Amazon RDS (MySQL)** environments, including parameter groups, backups, monitoring, performance, and secret rotation using AWS Secrets Manager.
* Design and maintain **AWS VPC networking**, including subnets, security groups, NAT gateways, load balancers, routing, and network security.
* Monitor and maintain infrastructure reliability using **Amazon CloudWatch**, including alarms, logs, dashboards, and operational monitoring.
* Design, maintain, and improve **CI/CD pipelines**, deployment workflows, and Amazon ECR image management.
* Develop, review, refactor, and maintain reusable **Terraform modules** and establish Infrastructure as Code best practices.
* Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Troubleshoot complex AWS, networking, container, deployment, and infrastructure issues in production environments.
* Implement and maintain appropriate **security, access control, backup, monitoring, and disaster recovery practices**.
* Maintain clear and up\-to\-date technical documentation for infrastructure, deployment processes, and operational procedures.
* Collaborate closely with the **CTO and development teams** to plan and implement infrastructure changes.
* Provide technical guidance and support to team members on AWS, Terraform, DevOps practices, and deployment processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* **3–5 years of professional experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or a related infrastructure role.**
* Strong hands\-on experience with **AWS** and production cloud environments.
* Strong working knowledge of **Terraform**, including the ability to design, write, review, and maintain reusable Terraform modules.
* Strong understanding of core AWS services, particularly **RDS, ECS, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, ECR, Secrets Manager, and load balancing**.
* Strong understanding of AWS networking fundamentals, including **subnets, security groups, routing, NAT gateways, and load balancers**.
* Hands\-on experience with **ECS Fargate** and containerized workloads.
* Strong knowledge of **Docker** and container deployment practices.
* Experience designing and maintaining **CI/CD pipelines**.
* Strong command\-line/Linux skills.
* Comfortable with **Git and version control workflows**.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of infrastructure, and make well\-considered technical decisions.
* Strong attention to detail and a focus on maintaining reliable and secure production infrastructure.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience managing **AWS Organizations and multi\-account AWS environments**.
* Experience working across Dev, QA, UAT, Production, Sandbox, and DevOps AWS accounts.
* Experience with **AWS Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, ECR, IAM, and automated secret rotation**.
* Experience with **Python or Bash scripting** for automation.
* Experience with infrastructure security and AWS cost optimization.
* Experience with monitoring, alerting, logging, and incident response.
* AWS certification such as **AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate/Professional** or **AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional**.
* Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance to junior DevOps engineers.

**Why Join Us?**

At JMSC POS, you’ll work directly with our **CTO** on real production infrastructure supporting **800–1,000 retail businesses across the United States**.

You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of a broad AWS and Terraform environment and work across **Infrastructure as Code, containers, networking, databases, monitoring, security, CI/CD, and cloud operations**.

This is an opportunity for a DevOps professional who wants to play an important role in building and improving reliable, scalable, and secure cloud infrastructure.

Interested candidates can **send their updated CV directly to** **aryanpatel@jmscpos.us**.

Pay: Up to ₹60,000\.00 per month
